column1: # NASA Biomass Production Chamber Crop Yield Data
# BPC: 20 m² facility at Kennedy Space Center
# Space requirement: 40-50 m2 per person for full caloric needs
# With insect protein supplementation: 35-40 m2 per person
# Key insight: Potato has highest edible productivity (18.4 g/m2/day)
# but wheat has highest total biomass (39.6 g/m2/day) for O2 production
